title: Zig and Sharko
description: On a desert island lives a starving hyena with one obsession: devour that delicious mermaid from the rock in the lagoon. But the lovely fish-girl’s best friend is a shark, a shark with a lot of muscle and who loves to sabotage the hyena’s every move.Please Note That Episode Numbers and Name Will not Match Because Episode List is Imported From TheMovieDatabse But Episodes are Ripped From Amazon Prime (Different Order)Season 1-2 is not available in Tamil-Telugu

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x1
episodes_data.description: Zig, a hyena living on an island, decides to eat the lovely mermaid, Marina, but Sharko, a strong shark, keeps blocking Zig's path.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x2
episodes_data.description: King Neptune tries to woo Marina, so Zig and Sharko must work together to bring her back.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x3
episodes_data.description: An oil spill makes the ocean slick and slimy, so Bernie finds a way to get rid of all the oil in the water.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x4
episodes_data.description: An oil spill makes the ocean slick and slimy, so Bernie finds a way to get rid of all the oil in the water.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x6
episodes_data.description: Zig battles a polar bear after the water freezes.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x7
episodes_data.description: Marina wants a pet, so she adopts Bernie and treats him like a pet.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x8
episodes_data.description: Zig helps Sharko rebuild Marina's house after it is destroyed.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x9
episodes_data.description: Zig builds some ships in order to eat Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x10
episodes_data.description: Marina dreams of being a flight attendant.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x11
episodes_data.description: Zig and Sharko join forces against a human castaway competing for Marina's affections.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x12
episodes_data.description: Zig finds interesting objects while digging a tunnel in his latest scheme to catch Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x13
episodes_data.description: Marina takes up water skiing using Sharko as her "boat"; Zig enlists a crazy dolphin's help to catch her.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x14
episodes_data.description: Marina nurses Zig back to health after one of Sharko's beatings.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x15
episodes_data.description: Bernie becomes a surrogate father to a lost herd of baby crabs.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x16
episodes_data.description: Zig and Bernie disguise an old submarine as a female shark to lure Sharko away from Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x17
episodes_data.description: Zig and Bernie discover a mannequin on the island, while Marina discovers something much more profound.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x18
episodes_data.description: A shrimp competes with Bernie as Zig's assistant.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x19
episodes_data.description: Zig tries to sabotage Sharko and Marina's dinner date.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x20
episodes_data.description: Zig tries using the active volcano against Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x21
episodes_data.description: A lighthouse is put up near the island after a fog roll in.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x22
episodes_data.description: Zig finds a wrecked boat on the shore and uses its cargo of bamboo in his latest scheme.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x23
episodes_data.description: Zig uses inflatable balloons to get to Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x24
episodes_data.description: Zig builds a boat out of LEGO-like building blocks to catch Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x25
episodes_data.description: Marina has to compete with another mermaid for Sharko's affections.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 1x26
episodes_data.description: Zig attempts to catch Marina while she plays golf with Sharko.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x1
episodes_data.description: Zig can't believe his luck when Marina decides to live on the beach in a sandcastle built by Sharko. zig and sharko get redesigns in this episode.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x2
episodes_data.description: Zig suddenly becomes popular and pretends to be a hero.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x3
episodes_data.description: Marina tries to re-educate the looney pilot living in the wrecked plane with Zig and Bernie.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x4
episodes_data.description: Sharko tries to impress Marina's father, King Poseidon.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x5
episodes_data.description: Zig becomes the playmate of a baby dolphin, who mistakes him for its lost doll.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x6
episodes_data.description: Zig and Bernie trick Marina and Sharko into thinking the wrecked plane can fly, and take them for a "ride".

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x7
episodes_data.description: Zig and Bernie get a taste of the good life when Marina invites them to live in her sandcastle.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x8
episodes_data.description: Bernie tricks Zig into thinking he has succeeded in killing and eating Marina. Deprived of his life's purpose, Zig sinks into depression.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x9
episodes_data.description: Zig lures Marina and Sharko into the jungle by telling them the pilot has been bitten by a koala.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x10
episodes_data.description: Everyone panics when a giant meteor heads for the island.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x11
episodes_data.description: Zig and Bernie throw a dance party to catch Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x12
episodes_data.description: Marina takes up surfing; Bernie steals Poseidon's trident so Zig can surf on huge waves.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x13
episodes_data.description: Zig disguises himself with a false mustache after getting himself banned from the island, but doesn't fool Sharko; Sharko similarly uses a wig after getting himself banned for beating up the "new guest".

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x14
episodes_data.description: A fisherman comes to the island and tries to capture Zig.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x15
episodes_data.description: Marina gives Sharko a pair of running shoes for a race, but they don't fit; Zig finds them and uses them to catch Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x16
episodes_data.description: A conquistador comes to the island and tries to take Marina for an aquarium display.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x17
episodes_data.description: A pod of orcas challenge Zig, Sharko, and Bernie to a game of rugby football.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x18
episodes_data.description: Sharko finds it's cleaning day in Marina's sandcastle; Zig and Bernie offer to "help".

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x19
episodes_data.description: Zig gives Sharko a whistle to distract him; Sharko takes his lifeguard job a little too seriously.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x20
episodes_data.description: Bernie turns Zig into a cyborg after a Sharko beatdown.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x21
episodes_data.description: Sharko and Zig open up a juice bar on the beach.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x22
episodes_data.description: Zig discovers Hades, the god of death, lives inside the volcano, and has fallen in love with Marina.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x23
episodes_data.description: Marina discovers Sharko is gaining weight, so Zig and Bernie turn her sandcastle into a spa.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x24
episodes_data.description: Zig becomes a magician to capture Marina but finds his magic is no match for Sharko's.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x25
episodes_data.description: When Marina becomes obsessed with candy, Zig uses it as bait; Sharko tries to get her to eat healthily.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 2x26
episodes_data.description: Bernie invents a deodorant that makes Zig irresistible to Marina; unfortunately it has the same effect on Sharko and everyone else (including Zig himself).

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x1
episodes_data.description: Marina dreams of sailing the sea, so Zig asks Bernie to build a cruise ship where all her friends can hop aboard! However, all awhile, Sharko believes this cruise vacation is another one of Zig's traps. When the boat is taking a dangerous course, Zig and Sharko are too busy bickering as always to save the day… who will come to the rescue?

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x2
episodes_data.description: Zig dresses up as a cute baby so that Marina takes care of him. But the mermaid is too busy and asks Sharko to babysit Zig! The shark develops strong paternal feelings towards the kid and is heartbroken when he finds out his true identity.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x3
episodes_data.description: Marina replaces the ship's nurse for the day, so Zig pretends to be hurt to be alone with her in the infirmary, but Sharko is not fooled and does the same thing.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x4
episodes_data.description: When the emergency alarm rings by mistake, everyone panics! Sharko decides to organize safety training to protect everyone in case of an emergency. But Marina isn’t a very serious student, and Zig sabotages the classes to seize the mermaid.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x5
episodes_data.description: When a huge thunderstorm forces everyone to go inside the ship, Zig takes advantage of Sharko's seasickness to catch Marina whenever she has to save passengers that got stuck outside.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x6
episodes_data.description: Zig sends Marina and Sharko on a fake treasure hunt in order to catch the mermaid, but they end up discovering a real abandoned galleon with cursed treasure inside.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x7
episodes_data.description: The baby swordfish starts idolizing Sharko to the point of repeating his every move, much to the shark's embarrassment.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x8
episodes_data.description: When the ship sinks underwater, Sharko tries to take the opportunity to kill some nostalgic memories of swimming in the ocean, but Marina forces him to help her fix the boat instead.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x9
episodes_data.description: Zig tries to eat Marina at night while she's sleeping, so Sharko must save her without making too much noise, as she gets extremely angry when woken up.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x10
episodes_data.description: Sharko must stop Marina from being lured into Zig's stomach during a game of blind man's buff.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x11
episodes_data.description: After accidentally tossing Sharko's fertilizer in the ocean, Marina creates a new one that makes all the plants in his garden grow huge. However, when Bernie's small carnivorous plant drinks an entire bottle of the substance, it turns into a giant monster.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x12
episodes_data.description: The ocean liner makes a stop off a magnificent desert island. When Sharko turns the beautiful beach into a garbage dump, Marina orders him to clean it up. Of course, Zig and Bernie turn his task into a nightmare to keep the shark busy.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x13
episodes_data.description: After a high-speed chase across the ship, Zig and Sharko get stuck inside the kitchen’s cold room. The shark and the hyena will soon have to forget their differences and combine forces to find a way out of this tricky situation...

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x14
episodes_data.description: After the ship crashes into an iceberg, Marina decides to explore it and befriends a penguin living there. However, once the ship is repaired, the creepy little bird refuses to let her or Sharko leave.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x15
episodes_data.description: Zig, Bernie, Sharko and Marina land in a labyrinth of corridors and pipes in the engine room. While Sharko tries to find the exit, Zig tries to grab Marina every time he is not looking.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x16
episodes_data.description: Marina gets a piece of parsley stuck in-between her teeth, but she does not notice it, even after Sharko tries to explain it to her. This causes the shark and the other cruisers to run away from her in disgust, except for Zig, who takes advantage of the situation in order to eat her.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x17
episodes_data.description: Olga-the-terrible, a Viking chieftain has fallen head over heels in love with Zig. He is quite happy to have her shield him against Sharko, but not so happy with the fact that she keeps him away from Marina who Olga sees as a rival…

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x18
episodes_data.description: Marina and Sharko are playing hide and seek, but the mermaid is not very good at hiding. However, she eventually finds a spot so good that neither the shark or Zig can find her, no matter how hard they look.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x19
episodes_data.description: Rats invade the boat! Marina tries to get rid of them and Sharko would like to help, but he is terrified by the rodents… Zig and Bernie will use his weakness to their advantage. Will Sharko be able to overcome his phobia to save Marina?

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x20
episodes_data.description: Sharko can’t stand gags and pranks, so Marina teams up with Zig and Bernie to loosen him up. But they take advantage and double-up their gags to overpower the shark. Is Sharko the only one who doesn’t have a sense of humor?

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x21
episodes_data.description: Sharko has a secret passion for synchronized swimming! Marina decides to make him the star of the swimming pool. Zig finds him absolutely ridiculous… and is very pleased to discover that mockery can be a powerful weapon against the shark!

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x22
episodes_data.description: Sharko's romantic dinner with Marina keeps getting interrupted by Bernie and Zig's constant attempts to smudge his fancy suit.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x23
episodes_data.description: Sharko is happy to be reunited with two old friends from his teenage years, but Marina isn't very fond of their rebellious ways.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x24
episodes_data.description: Hades visits the ship in order to finally get a kiss from Marina, but she could be more horrified of him.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x25
episodes_data.description: Marina has a new obsession: giant robots! This gives Zig an idea, maybe he could defeat Sharko with the right armor. But Sharko has no trouble beating up Zig-Robot… until the hyena shows up in a real giant robot.

episodes_data.title: Zig and Sharko 3x26
episodes_data.description: Marina and Sharko wanted to buy a dinner robot and Zig had an idea to eat to make Bernie a robot and his income but the real dinner robot came and his Zig vacation unintentionally began to crash.
